name: aws_ec2_high_cpu
title: EC2 CPU above 80%
description: An EC2 instance averaged more than 80% CPU over the last 20 minutes. Sustained saturation comes before latency and timeouts. Batch, CI and burstable hosts may run hot by design.

query_condition.sql: SELECT dimensions_instanceid AS instance, account_id, region, sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) AS avg_cpu FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" WHERE namespace = 'AWS/EC2' AND metric_name = 'CPUUtilization' AND dimensions_instanceid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY instance, account_id, region HAVING sum(value_sum) / sum(value_count) > 80
